newsitem.title: USA: Firm commits funds to Time Warner unit buyout.
newsitem.headline: Firm commits funds to Time Warner unit buyout.

text.p: Brantley Capital Corp, a private business development company, said Tuesday it had committed to invest $1.35 million in Fitness Quest Inc, a unit of Time Warner Inc's Music Group.

The purchase is part of a management buyout of Fitness Quest, a direct marketing and distribution company in the fitness promotional products business, according to Tab Keplinger, a spokesman for Brantley.
Keplinger did not disclose how the rest of the buyout would be funded.
Brantley said it would make its investment through a related partnership, Brantley Venture Partners III L.P.
The partnership has agreed to buy about 787,500 Class A convertible preferred shares of Fitness Quest at $1.71 each, representing a 16 percent stake in the company.
The shares being purchased are part of a $3.85 million preferred stock issue of Fitness Quest.

Brantley said the commitment to Fitness Quest is subject to the Securities and Exchange Commission granting an order that would permit it to be an investment partner of Brantley Venture in Fitness Quest and in other transactions.
